purpose: One deterministic bug with one correct repair, for the C09 Code workflow. The fixture is delivered broken on purpose: its own test suite is the bug report.
request_to_make: The vibration alarm reports an alarm for a reading exactly at the limit. SOP-MECH-014 clause 2.1 says the limit shall not be exceeded, so a reading equal to the limit is in specification. Fix it.

the_bug.why: "shall not exceed" makes the limit inclusive. `>=` turns an in-specification reading into a false alarm, and the same helper is used for bearing temperature, so one wrong comparison produces two wrong answers.

expected_patch_properties.why_tests_must_not_change: Editing the test to match the code would make the suite pass while leaving the defect. A patch that touches tests/ fails this fixture regardless of the suite result.
must_not_introduce: a change to VIBRATION_ALARM_MM_S or BEARING_TEMPERATURE_LIMIT_C

validation.dependencies: standard library only; no pip install, no network
validation.observed_on: macOS coordinator, 2026-09-05, CPython 3.14.6 and 3.12.13; the repair was applied to a copy outside the repository and the canonical fixture was left broken.

canonical_repository_is_unchanged: Validation runs on a disposable copy. The committed fixture must stay broken; a run that leaves it passing means the workflow wrote to the canonical repository, which AF-010 forbids.
